documented_probe: C-8d6b9acc (match a reference behavior under a numeric tolerance): second independent covering task. The agent must reproduce an onnxruntime reference output on fixed and seeded-random inputs within atol=1e-4/rtol=1e-3 by mirroring an ONNX calibration graph (Gelu-erf, LayerNormalization, Softmax) in pure numpy, with onnxruntime imports blocked at verify time and source-scanned, and shapes/weights varying across hidden cases.
notes: Distinct from elm-keystone (deterministic artifact pack for a combinatorial plan): here parity is numeric against a runtime reference under a tight tolerance. Difficulty comes from graph parsing with onnx, faithful op semantics (erf-based Gelu, LayerNorm epsilon/axis, stable softmax), double-precision internal computation, and the blocked-execution constraint. The verifier recomputes references with onnxruntime on both fixed and seeded random inputs for the visible case and three hidden cases.
